label: prf:surreal-squeeze
title: Proof of surreal squeeze
html:
Proof. Multiply both sides by the strictly positive element \varepsilon to obtain the equivalent inequality

\delta^2 > \varepsilon^4.

Since \varepsilon is a positive infinitesimal (Reeb infinitesimal, positivity and archimedean smallness), every positive integer multiple n \cdot \varepsilon^4 is still bounded above by any standard real. In particular \varepsilon^4 < \delta^2. \square
heading: Proof
